steps.title: Read the contributing guide
steps.body: It covers the canary branch, commit style and what reviewers check before they approve.

steps.title: Pick a good first issue
steps.body: Each one is small and already triaged, so nobody is waiting on a design decision before you start.

steps.title: Run the tests locally
steps.body: Build once, then run the suite that covers the files you changed.

steps.title: Ask in Discussions
steps.body: Post in the Help category if you get stuck. Most threads get an answer the same day.

steps.title: Install the toolchain
steps.body: Run `corepack enable` so the repo's pinned pnpm is used, then `pnpm install` from the root.

steps.title: Build once, then watch
steps.body: `pnpm build` compiles every package. Leave `pnpm dev` running while you edit.

steps.title: Run only what you changed
steps.body: Pass a path to `pnpm test-dev`, such as `test/e2e/app-dir/navigation`, to run one suite.

steps.title: Find an issue to fix
steps.body: Issues labeled good first issue are small and come with a reproduction.

steps.title: Sign the contributor agreement
steps.body: Meta needs it once before any pull request can merge. It takes a minute.

steps.title: Run the tests for your package
steps.body: Then run lint and Flow, so the checks pass on your first push.

warming.nextCheck: usually under a minute · checking again in 12s
